overview_description.description:
Abacus.AI is an artificial intelligence research and cloud services company that helps organizations design, train, and operationalize machine and deep learning models. It allows organizations to plug and play deep learning systems into their existing customer experiences and business processes.

The company was founded in 2019 and is based in San Francisco, California.

product.name: Abacus.AI Enterprise
product.description: An enterprise AI platform for building and deploying generative AI applications, machine-learning models, and automated workflows on organizational data.

product.name: ChatLLM
product.description: An AI assistant for professionals and small teams that provides access to multiple language, image, and video models for chat, coding, research, document analysis, and custom AI applications.

product.name: Abacus AI Deep Agent
product.description: A general-purpose AI agent that uses research, coding, browser automation, integrations, and data tools to create applications and automate multi-step professional tasks.

product.name: Abacus AI Desktop
product.description: A desktop AI coding environment for generating features, fixing bugs, auditing repositories, and working with code through an integrated development workflow.

product.name: Structured ML
product.description: A machine-learning service for building models from structured data, including predictive modeling, personalization, forecasting, and anomaly detection.

product.name: Optimization
product.description: An AI and mathematical optimization service for allocating resources, scheduling operations, setting prices, and optimizing decisions under business constraints.
